short_description: A two-hour guided limo tour of Los Angeles’ most notorious true crime, scandal and paranormal sites.
cancellation_summary: Tours may be canceled for low bookings; no refund for late arrivals; refunds only if operator cancels or in specific circumstances described by operator.
location_address: 6801 Hollywood Boulevard Los Angeles, CA US 90028
accessibility: Vehicles are older limousines that may not meet modern accessibility standards; limited accommodation for mobility devices.
description: Sink into a custom funeral limo and glide through Hollywood, West Hollywood, and Beverly Hills while a storyteller threads together scandals, murders, overdoses, and paranormal lore. This atmospheric two-hour ride blends true crime history with noir-style narration, curated audio, and visual background materials to make each stop feel cinematic. From infamous hotels and crime scenes to celebrity mansions and haunted landmarks, the tour reveals the darker stories behind glamour and neon, turning familiar streets into a riveting moving crime scene.

what_is_included_items.value: Two-hour sightseeing tour of Los Angeles’ notorious true crime and paranormal locations
Access to a visual gallery for mourners with cell phone data services
Guided storytelling and curated audio within the limo
Atmospheric lighting and visual background materials in the vehicle

itinerary:
1. Highland Gardens Hotel (Janis Joplin overdose site)
2. Sunset Grove double homicide and beheading
3. North Orange Grove Avenue ("Halloween" movie houses)
4. Former Ed Buck apartment
5. Barney's Beanery
6. West Hollywood condo murder (Blake Leibel case)
7. Beverly Hills jewelry heist site
8. Spadena House (Witch's House)
9. Howard Hughes plane crash site on Linden Drive
10. Bugsy Siegel murder site at 810 North Linden Drive
11. Beverly Hills Bermuda Triangle on Whittier Drive
12. Michael Jackson's Carolwood Drive home
13. Lana Turner/Johnny Stompanato site on North Bedford Drive
14. Menendez Mansion on North Elm Drive
15. Greystone Mansion murder-suicide site
16. Viper Room (River Phoenix overdose site)
17. Brittany Murphy's final Hollywood Hills home
18. Sunset Tower hauntings
19. Chateau Marmont scandals
20. Sunset Strip (Sunset Slayers story)
highlights:
* Ride in a custom funeral limo with atmospheric lighting and curated audio
* Expert storytelling that brings victims, killers, and scandals vividly to life
* Visit an extensive list of iconic and notorious Los Angeles true crime and paranormal sites
* Immersive visual gallery accessible via cell phone data during the tour
check_in_details: Meet at Ovation Hollywood (6801 Hollywood Blvd). A mortuary associate will welcome guests at the meeting point 20 minutes before boarding; arrive 15–20 minutes early at the meeting point. Tours depart on time and late arrivals cannot join or be rescheduled.

what_to_bring_items.value: Government-issued ID if required for verification

special_requirements: Tours contain graphic descriptions and explicit images; not recommended for children under 12. Individuals under 18 must be accompanied by a parent or legal guardian.
restrictions: No luggage or strollers may be accommodated. No eating, smoking or drinking on tours (bottled water with caps allowed). Pets and infants under age 5 are prohibited.
disclaimers: Operator may cancel tours for low bookings. Tours operate regardless of weather unless safety is at risk; tours leave as scheduled and late arrivals will not be reimbursed. Vehicles are older thirty-year-old limousines and may have wear-and-tear; operator is not liable for certain damages or events beyond its control. In the event of a breakdown, operator will return passengers to the departure point and issue a full refund of the ticket cost. Passengers may be asked to reschedule or refunded if vehicle capacity, weight, or safety concerns arise.
